أكتنز (form VIII)
# أَكْتَنِزُ (ʔaktanizu) /ʔak.ta.ni.zu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# أُكْتَنَزُ (ʔuktanazu) /ʔuk.ta.na.zu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# أَكْتَنِزَ (ʔaktaniza) /ʔak.ta.ni.za/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# أُكْتَنَزَ (ʔuktanaza) /ʔuk.ta.na
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
